book.name: 2 TESALONICENSES
book.title: ISCAB CARTA NAJ SAN PABLO YATO TET MACTA AYXACO YUL ISKꞌAB COMAM BEY TESALÓNICA

content: Txahlan̈we jin̈an̈

Wal tinan̈, hex wuẍtaj hex wanab, txahlan̈we jin̈an̈, haxinwal yin̈ an̈e chiapni Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios sunil baytajtuꞌwal, yeb yun̈e istzala iscꞌul anma ischahnicanoj, hacaꞌ yu istzala hecꞌul yet heyanico heba yul iskꞌab Comam.
Txahlan̈wepaxo yu con̈iscolnilojan̈ Comam Dios yul iskꞌab anma machiswalil yeb txꞌoj isnabal, yuto mach sunilo anma chichahnayto Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios yul yanma.
Wal Comam Dios chij isba sunil tzet chala, haꞌ Comam chexiptzeni, cat quexiscolni yul iskꞌab istxꞌojal.
Chicawxi cocꞌulan̈ yin̈ Comam Dios tato ayexico heyijen sunil tzet chijalan̈ teyet, yeb ta caw chelahico heyijeni.
Haꞌojab Comam Jesucristo chicolwa teyin̈, haxinwal cheyohtan̈e ta xahan ayex yu Comam Dios, cat xin istecha sunil isyaꞌtajil heyu yu yip Comam Jesucristo.
Sunil mac yilal ismunlahi

Hex wuẍtaj hex wanab, yin̈ isbi Cocolomal Jesucristo chijaltojan̈ huneꞌ chejbanile tiꞌ teyet tato chepohilo heba yin̈ ebnaj juẍta mach chisje iscꞌul munlahoj, yeb mach chisyije cuybanile halbilcano teyet juhan̈.
Yuto heyohtaxaticꞌa tzet wal heyuni, hacaꞌ yebil teyet juhan̈. Han̈on̈tiꞌan̈ yet ayon̈an̈ texol machi hunu tzꞌayical tiꞌ mach con̈munlahan̈.
Heyohtaj tato mach ton̈eho con̈waꞌan̈ texol, wal xin con̈munlahan̈ tzꞌayical yeb akꞌbalil yun̈e matzet chicokꞌanan̈ teyet.
Waxan̈ca xin ay jipan̈ cokꞌannihan̈ tzet chicolohan̈ teyet, yaj con̈munlahan̈ yun̈e coyenicanojan̈ tato hac tuꞌ cheyutepaxoj.
Yet ayon̈an̈ texol tuꞌ, chijalnihan̈ huneꞌ cuybanile tiꞌ: “Mac mach chisje iscꞌul chimunlahi, machojab chiwaꞌpaxoj,” con̈chiyan̈.
Yaj xin xajabepaxojan̈ tato ay mac texol tuꞌ ton̈e chieqꞌui, mach chimunlahi; ton̈e chilo istiempo anma.
Haꞌ tet huntekꞌan anma tuꞌ chijaltojan̈ yu yip Comam Jesucristo tato munlahojab yin̈ akꞌancꞌulal, haxinwal haꞌ caw chiikꞌni tzet chislo.
Hex wuẍtaj hex wanab, machojab chexsiquilo hewatxꞌen iscꞌulal.
Tato ay mac mach chiyijen tzet chijaltojan̈ yul huneꞌ hum tiꞌ, ton̈eojab cheyila maca matxa xin chehunba heba yebi haxinwal chitxꞌixwican̈.
Yaj xin mach cheyaco hehowal yin̈, wal xin cuywe yin̈ istoholal, yuto juẍtapaxo yehi.
Yet yalnito naj Pablo ta chil isba macta ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Dios
Haꞌojab Comam yahawil akꞌancꞌulal chiakꞌni akꞌancꞌulal teyet hesunil yin̈ sunilbal tiempo. Tzalahojab hecꞌul, waxan̈ca ay biscꞌulal chiay texol. Ayojabn̈eticꞌaco Comam heyetbiho hesunil.
Wal hanin Pablo intiꞌan, han-caw-inan chintzꞌibn̈etojan tato cheyil heba yin̈ hecawil. Inbihan chioc yin̈ huneꞌ hum tiꞌ hacaꞌ chu intzꞌibn̈entojan sunilej incartahan.
Haꞌojab Comam Jesucristo chiakꞌni iscꞌulchꞌanil teyet hesunil. ¡Hacojab tuꞌ!
